quest.title: The Ritou Road
quest.description: You happen upon a hidden passageway in Ritou...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x5

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Well, so this stuff's finally arrived...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Agh, and this box is broken on one side, too!

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Come on! I told him to be careful. Let's just hope nothing inside is broken...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Phew, looks like none of the bottles broke...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Eh? Why's this bottle's cap loose? You have to unscrew it first before installing it, come on...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: *cough* And these alcohol-making ingredients have too strong a flavor, let's move them out first...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Eh!? What are all these slimes doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: Thank you, Traveler, thank you so much for your help...

dialogues.speaker: Harrison
dialogues.text: If not for you, this place would have been my grave today...

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: I mean, you know that doing business is hard here on Ritou. This camp is... well, you can consider it a little trick of mine.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: Some days back, I commissioned a... friend to ship me some alcohol-making ingredients from Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: He then got a test batch of new product from the Dawn Winery, which was just shipped here.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: But he hasn't been all that careful, so some of the boxes are broken, and the cap on a bottle of alcohol-making ingredients was loosened.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: I decided to unscrew it so that I could then reinstall it.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: But I never expected that a whole bunch of slimes would come jumping out of the unscrewed cap. What a strange occurrence.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Brewing ingredients from the Dawn Winery, huh...

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: Ah, it doesn't matter right now. As for the ingredients, I'll settle with that fellow the next time he comes by.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: You've saved my life, and I owe you something for it. Take these first, then.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: That aside, you see that small boat over there? That's another one of my little tricks.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: Using that boat, you can sneak over to Narukami Island from here. Convenient, huh?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And why would I need to "sneak"...

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: Ah, you see, this is what they call "expecting the unexpected."

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: Well, I need to go back and take stock of those goods, so I can't stay here long. Once again, thank you so much, Traveler.

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: Looks like I'll have to change up my pick-up spot.

choices.text: What are you up to here?

response.speaker: Harrison
response.text: I'm, ah, moving goods! Moving goods...
